"""Pure core for the review script.

The only subprocess is ``pi``, and it runs through ``main``. Every other
function here is pure and free of side effects so it can be unit tested in
the default (no-model, no-subprocess) tier.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
from argparse import ArgumentParser, Namespace
from pathlib import Path

REVIEW_DIRNAME = "reviews"
REVIEW_EXTENSION = ".md"


def provider_and_model(spec: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Split a ``provider/model`` spec into its two parts.

    ``"zai/glm-5.3"`` becomes ``("zai", "glm-5.3")``. A spec without a
    slash is rejected with a ``ValueError`` whose message names the
    ``provider/model`` shape.
    """
    if "/" not in spec:
        raise ValueError(
            f"model spec {spec!r} is missing a slash; expected provider/model"
        )
    provider, model = spec.split("/", 1)
    if not provider or not model:
        raise ValueError(f"model spec {spec!r} has an empty provider or model")
    return provider, model


def refuse_if_exists(path: Path) -> None:
    """Raise ``FileExistsError`` only when ``path`` already exists."""
    if path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"refusing to overwrite existing review {path}")


def _commit_bounds(commit_range: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    commit_range = commit_range.strip()
    if ".." in commit_range:
        start, end = commit_range.split("..", 1)
        return start.strip(), end.strip()
    single = commit_range.strip()
    return single, ""


def review_path(root: Path, commit_range: str, model: str) -> Path:
    """Return the destination path for a review.

    The path is ``docs/reviews/<start>..<end>-<model-slug>.md`` where the
    model slug replaces every ``/`` with ``-``.
    """
    start, end = _commit_bounds(commit_range)
    slug = model.replace("/", "-")
    return Path(
        root
        / REVIEW_DIRNAME
        / f"{start}..{end}-{slug}{REVIEW_EXTENSION}"
    )


def build_prompt(diff: str, range_label: str) -> str:
    """Build the prompt handed to the model for a diff.

    The returned text includes the ``range_label`` verbatim, the ``diff``
    verbatim, and the literal words ``Accept`` and ``itemized``.
    """
    return (
        f"Review the following change for {range_label}.\n"
        "\n"
        "Respond with an itemized list of issues, then a verdict. "
        "If the change is acceptable, your verdict must contain the word "
        "Accept.\n"
        "\n"
        f"=== {range_label} ===\n"
        f"{diff}\n"
        "=== end diff ===\n"
    )


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
    """Run ``pi`` with the built prompt and write its stdout to the path."""
    parser = ArgumentParser(description="Generate a review for a diff.")
    parser.add_argument("--provider", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--model", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--root", default=Path.cwd(), type=Path)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--range",
        required=True,
        help="commit range, e.g. abc123..def456",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--diff", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    provider, model = provider_and_model(args.model)
    path = review_path(args.root, args.range, model)
    refuse_if_exists(path)
    prompt = build_prompt(args.diff, args.range)

    command = [
        "pi",
        "-p",
        "--no-session",
        "--no-extensions",
        "--no-skills",
        "-nc",
        f"--provider {provider}",
        f"--model {model}",
        "--exclude-tools",
        "write,edit",
        prompt,
    ]
    proc = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        sys.stderr.write(proc.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(proc.returncode)
    path.write_text(proc.stdout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

"""Default-tier tests for the review script's pure core."""

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from tools.review import (
    build_prompt,
    provider_and_model,
    refuse_if_exists,
    review_path,
)


def test_provider_and_model_splits_on_first_slash() -> None:
    assert provider_and_model("zai/glm-5.3") == ("zai", "glm-5.3")


def test_provider_and_model_rejects_a_spec_without_slash() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as caught:
        provider_and_model("glm-5.3")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    assert "provider/model" in str(caught.value)


def test_refuse_if_exists_raises_only_when_the_path_exists(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    target = tmp_path / "does-not-exist.md"
    refuse_if_exists(target)  # no raise

    target.write_text("stale")
    with pytest.raises(FileExistsError):
        refuse_if_exists(target)


def test_review_path_encodes_the_range_and_model_slug(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    expected = tmp_path / "docs" / "reviews" / "a1b2..c3d4-glm-5.3.md"
    assert review_path(tmp_path, "a1b2..c3d4", "zai/glm-5.3") == expected


def test_build_prompt_carries_label_diff_and_verdict_words() -> None:
    diff = "def foo():\n    return 1\n"
    prompt = build_prompt(diff, "the nightly merge")
    assert "the nightly merge" in prompt
    assert diff in prompt
    assert "Accept" in prompt
    assert "itemized" in prompt


def test_review_path_slashes_in_the_model_become_dashes(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    expected = tmp_path / "docs" / "reviews" / "a..b-open-model-v2.md"
    assert review_path(tmp_path, "a..b", "open/model/v2") == expected
